verdict.rationale: Render documents built-in metrics for Render infrastructure and the ability to stream telemetry to external tools. The evidence never shows a first-party custom dashboard builder that combines metrics from any service. Streaming telemetry to third-party tools would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service

citations.quote: See critical metrics for all of your Render infrastructure from day zero, and stream telemetry to external tools.
